question: Each of K, L, M, N and P has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. No exam is held on Friday and Saturday. Only two persons have exams between N and M. L's exam is held on Wednesday. Only one person has exam between N and L. P's exam is held on Sunday. Whose exam is held on Monday?
